protocol: Serial GPU runs; validation disabled; 3 trials per case, 500 warmup plus 500 timed frames per variant, variant order alternates by trial. NativeRenderer render/submit/wait included; compilation and readback excluded. Same actual checkerboard backdrop four-pass RGBA16F blur, 128 translucent layer ordinary control, and SourceAlpha/offset/two-axis blur/two-input composition graph. Graph compares custom application source-over shader with built-in Over, using otherwise identical scenes and passes. Baseline binary frozen before indexed input/output-growth changes; candidate after shared physical-DPI damage fix. Graph variants use candidate binary.
